<thought>The mass spectrum shows a clear isotopic envelope spaced ~1.003 Da apart with relative intensities 100 : 14 : 1.1 : 0.07 … This matches the natural 13C distribution for a molecule containing ~13 carbons. No characteristic M+2 pattern of Cl, Br, S, etc., is present, so only carbon can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
